definitions.explanation: A ceremony held for a deceased person before burial or cremation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{葬式|そうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参列|さんれつ}した→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧。
{葬式|そうしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The funeral will be held next Monday.
I wear black clothes to funerals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}に→急に：00263_kyuuni⟧{葬式|そうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}なければならなくなった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I suddenly had to attend a funeral.

examples.japanese: {葬式|そうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あとで→後で：00920_atode⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After the funeral, the relatives gathered for a meal.

notes:
{葬式|そうしき} is a common word for funeral. In Japan, most funerals follow Buddhist traditions, though practices vary by region and religion.

FUNERAL-RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{通夜|つや}→通夜：16026_tsuya⟧: wake (evening before the funeral)
- ⟦{告別式|こくべつしき}→告別式：05923_kokubetsushiki⟧: farewell ceremony
- ⟦{火葬|かそう}→火葬：13379_kasou⟧: cremation
- ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧: condolence money
- ⟦{喪服|もふく}→喪服：11898_mofuku⟧: mourning clothes

FUNERAL CUSTOMS:
- Guests typically give ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧ (money in a special envelope)
- ⟦{焼香|しょうこう}→焼香：16425_shoukou⟧: offering incense
- Most Japanese funerals are Buddhist
- Cremation is the norm in Japan

FORMAL SYNONYM:
- ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧: funeral (more formal)
